title: Capuchin monkeys reject unequal pay
summary: Primatologist Frans de Waal shows an experiment in which capuchin monkeys refuse a reward after seeing a partner get a better one for the same task. It illustrates a sense of fairness in primates.
why: HN cites it in discussions of pay fairness and inequality as a short, funny demonstration of the fairness instinct.

quote.text: it's a short video and pretty hilarious, worth a watch
